boundary: Re-resolved observations at eighteen pinned native checkpoints and the pinned pre-change master git blobs. Equal observations do not exhaust source literature or prove no improvement is possible. New engineering/source-fidelity controls do not satisfy missing specialist, primary-edition or human-outcome criteria. This replays the inherited 43-package state; later scoped-control closures are tracked separately in references/scoped-closures-2026-10-25.md, not reversed by this receipt.
